findings.summary: A driver without restore releases the stored snapshot before pre-turn checks that can prevent its turn (reproduced: max_driver_turns=1, restart on NotesDriver, resume input -> BUDGET_EXHAUSTED persists a null snapshot with zero driver calls).

A dict key literally named items inherits a declared array-member class: schema-valid {"x":{"items":{"label":"SEEDED-PERSONAL"}}} reaches an undeclared hosted route unmasked under /output/x/items/label public.
